title: The Seven Unfoldings — the heptad mapped

transform_classes.M: elaborative unfolding — the seed's structure expanded, its terms retained, its ruling kept
transform_classes.M̄: adversarial unfolding — the seed's terms retained, its ruling negotiated or inverted; the epistle argues with its seed
transform_classes.X: canonical mechanism — the exchange or carriage of the letter recorded in the canon itself

letters.name: Ephesus

seed.name: first love abandoned
seed.greek: tēn agapēn sou tēn prōtēn aphēkes
seed.quote: thou hast left thy first love

seed.name: false apostles tried
seed.greek: epeirasas tous legontas heautous apostolous… kai heures autous pseudeis
seed.quote: thou hast tried them which say they are apostles, and are not, and hast found them liars

seed.name: remember and repeat
seed.greek: mnēmoneue oun pothen peptōkas… ta prōta erga poiēson
seed.quote: remember therefore from whence thou art fallen… and do the first works

seed.name: tree of life promise
seed.greek: dōsō autō phagein ek tou xylou tēs zōēs
seed.quote: To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the tree of life

rules.gloss: the abandoned prōtē agapē becomes the epistle's spine: the love-command held ap' archēs
the act of testing false apostles becomes a standing forensic doctrine, with the liars given their exit narrative

emissions.produces: The love held from the beginning

matches.greek: hautē estin hē angelia hēn ēkousate ap' archēs, hina agapōmen allēlous
matches.quote: For this is the message that ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another
matches.note: the FIRST love as the FROM-THE-BEGINNING love-command — firstness transposed from time-of-falling to time-of-hearing

matches.greek: entolēn palaian hēn eichete ap' archēs
matches.quote: no new commandment… but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning
matches.note: remember-and-repeat as doctrine: nothing new; return to the first

emissions.produces: Trying the spirits; the liars' exit

matches.greek: dokimazete ta pneumata
matches.quote: believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out
matches.note: epeirasas → dokimazete: the completed act of Ephesus made a standing imperative

matches.greek: ex hēmōn exēlthan, all' ouk ēsan ex hēmōn
matches.quote: They went out from us, but they were not of us
matches.note: 'found them liars' unfolded into the secession narrative — where the false ones went

emissions.honesty: The tree-of-life promise reaches 1 John only as the zōē aiōnios theme (5:11–13) — thematic, not lexical. Residue: Cain (3:12), water-blood-Spirit (5:6–8), the idols closing (5:21). Curiosity cutting against the nominal alternative: 'in Ephesus' is absent from the earliest witnesses of Ephesians (P46, ℵ*, B*).

emissions.name: Smyrna
emissions.honesty: The granular executable case — nine elements, eight rules, two unique-in-canon anchors, the dōsō→epēngeilato arrow, residue displayed. Run it at the link.

emissions.name: Pergamum

seed.name: Satan's throne
seed.greek: hopou ho thronos tou Satana
seed.quote: thou dwellest, even where Satan's seat is
seed.gloss: the imperial cult seat of Asia

seed.name: Antipas the witness
seed.greek: Antipas ho martys mou ho pistos
seed.quote: Antipas was my faithful martyr, who was slain among you

seed.name: the doctrine of Balaam
seed.greek: phagein eidōlothyta kai porneusai
seed.quote: the doctrine of Balaam… to eat things sacrificed unto idols, and to commit fornication

seed.name: the stumbling-block
seed.greek: balein skandalon enōpion tōn huiōn Israēl
seed.quote: to cast a stumblingblock before the children of Israel

seed.name: hidden manna promise
seed.greek: dōsō autō tou manna tou kekrymmenou
seed.quote: To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the hidden manna

seed.name: white stone, new name
seed.greek: psēphon leukēn… onoma kainon gegrammenon
seed.quote: a white stone, and in the stone a new name written

rules.gloss: the seed's forbidden eidōlothyta becomes the epistle's permitted-with-conscience: same term, inverted ruling
the epistle answers the charge inside itself: the same Peor fornication, cited as its own caution
the promise-food becomes typological table-food in the same pericope
the seed's skandalon returns as the boundary on the inverted ruling

matches.greek: peri de tōn eidōlothytōn… brōma de hēmas ou parastēsei tō theō
matches.quote: Now as touching things offered unto idols… meat commendeth us not to God
matches.note: the canon's only sustained eidōlothyta treatise — and it permits (10:25 'whatsoever is sold, eat') what the seed condemns. Same term, inverted ruling: the adversarial class in one verse.

emissions.produces: The Peor fornication, deployed as warning

matches.greek: mēde porneuōmen, kathōs tines autōn eporneusan, kai epesan… eikosi treis chiliades
matches.quote: Neither let us commit fornication, as some of them committed, and fell in one day three and twenty thousand
matches.note: Numbers 25 — Baal-Peor, Balaam's device (Num 31:16). The epistle cites the very incident the seed's charge names, while ruling differently on the food. The knot tightens: same incident, both texts.

matches.greek: pantes to auto pneumatikon brōma ephagon
matches.quote: and did all eat the same spiritual meat
matches.note: the hidden manna of the promise, typologized at the same table where the idol-food question is being ruled — third element of the knot, same pericope

matches.greek: mē pōs hē exousia hymōn hautē proskomma genētai
matches.quote: take heed lest by any means this liberty of yours become a stumblingblock to them that are weak
matches.note: skandalon → proskomma: the seed's accusation term becomes the epistle's own boundary on the permission it grants

emissions.honesty: Four seed elements land in one Corinthian pericope — the densest knot in the space. But the class is M̄: the epistle NEGOTIATES its seed, retaining every term while inverting the ruling; under Revelation-first the seed already knows the unfolding it must resist. Suggestive, not probative: the white stone's new name against the renamed apostle (the Saul→Paul mediation runs through Acts 13:9). Residue: Antipas has no Corinthian unfold (his apparatus is held at deposit #165, the Pergamon Counter-Archive); Satan's throne is frame, not lexical match.

emissions.name: Thyatira

seed.name: the increase formula
seed.greek: ta erga sou ta eschata pleiona tōn prōtōn
seed.quote: thy works, and charity, and service, and faith, and thy patience… and the last to be more than the first

seed.name: morning star promise
seed.greek: dōsō autō ton astera ton prōinon
seed.quote: And I will give him the morning star

seed.name: hold fast till I come
seed.greek: plēn ho echete kratēsate achris hou an hēxō
seed.quote: that which ye have already hold fast till I come

rules.sig: morning star → lights in the world
rules.gloss: the star given to the overcomer becomes the assembly shining

matches.greek: hina hē agapē hymōn eti mallon kai mallon perisseuē
matches.quote: that your love may abound yet more and more
matches.note: the increase formula as prayer — the only letter praised for growth maps to the epistle of abounding

matches.greek: phainesthe hōs phōstēres en kosmō, logon zōēs epechontes
matches.quote: among whom ye shine as lights in the world; holding forth the word of life
matches.note: the promised star distributed to the assembly, with the word of life in hand

matches.greek: houtōs stēkete en kyriō
matches.quote: so stand fast in the Lord, my dearly beloved
matches.note: hold-fast-till-I-come as the epistle's closing embrace

emissions.honesty: The route runs through a person: Lydia of Thyatira, seller of purple, is the one named Thyatiran in the NT — and she founds the Philippian assembly (Acts 16:14). The letter reaches its epistle by carriage. Mediated through Acts, therefore B−. Jezebel is residue: no Philippian unfold.

emissions.name: Sardis

seed.name: the living name, dead
seed.greek: onoma echeis hoti zēs, kai nekros ei
seed.quote: thou hast a name that thou livest, and art dead

seed.name: watch
seed.greek: ginou grēgorōn
seed.quote: Be watchful, and strengthen the things which remain

seed.name: the thief
seed.greek: hēxō hōs kleptēs
seed.quote: I will come on thee as a thief

rules.sig: the thief → the day as thief
rules.gloss: the threat to one assembly becomes the shape of the day itself
grēgoreō made the community's standing posture

emissions.produces: The day comes as a thief

matches.greek: hēmera kyriou hōs kleptēs en nykti houtōs erchetai
matches.quote: the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night
matches.note: the closest verbal parallel of the image in the epistles — the seed's hēxō hōs kleptēs generalized from visitation to day

emissions.produces: Watch; do not sleep; the dead live

matches.greek: mē katheudōmen hōs hoi loipoi, alla grēgorōmen
matches.quote: let us not sleep, as do others; but let us watch and be sober
matches.note: the Sardis imperative as first-person-plural ethic

matches.greek: hina eite grēgorōmen eite katheudōmen hama syn autō zēsōmen
matches.quote: that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him
matches.note: the living-name-dead paradox resolved: the dead who live

emissions.honesty: Two shared collocations, neither unique: the thief also at 2 Pet 3:10 and in the Jesus-tradition. The white-raiment element finds no Thessalonian unfold. Grade held at B.

emissions.name: Philadelphia

seed.name: the open door
seed.greek: thyran ēneōgmenēn, hēn oudeis dynatai kleisai
seed.quote: behold, I have set before thee an open door, and no man can shut it

seed.name: little strength, word kept
seed.greek: mikran echeis dynamin, kai etērēsas mou ton logon
seed.quote: thou hast a little strength, and hast kept my word

rules.gloss: the epistle names the letter's subject and declines to elaborate it

emissions.produces: The unfolding that announces its own omission

matches.greek: peri de tēs philadelphias ou chreian echete graphein hymin
matches.quote: But as touching brotherly love ye need not that I write unto you
matches.note: the wittiest datum in the space: an epistle raises philadelphia by name — and declines to write it. Under the unfolding thesis: the seed kept its word so well that its elaboration is announced as unnecessary.

matches.greek: hē philadelphia menetō
matches.quote: Let brotherly love continue
matches.note: not begin — CONTINUE: the imperative presupposes philadelphia already present and held

emissions.honesty: Split, and left split. The open door is Pauline mission idiom (1 Cor 16:9; 2 Cor 2:12; Col 4:3) — distributed, not concentrated. Possible reading: Philadelphia, the letter with no rebuke, is the seed whose unfolding is distributed rather than gathered — kept, continued, never argued. Grade C+ held; heteronym unresolved.

emissions.name: Laodicea

seed.name: the Amēn, the witness
seed.greek: ho Amēn, ho martys ho pistos kai alēthinos
seed.quote: These things saith the Amen, the faithful and true witness

seed.name: the beginning of creation
seed.greek: hē archē tēs ktiseōs tou theou
seed.quote: the beginning of the creation of God

seed.name: the self-styled rich
seed.greek: legeis hoti plousios eimi… kai ouden chreian echō
seed.quote: thou sayest, I am rich, and increased with goods, and have need of nothing

seed.name: white raiment for nakedness
seed.greek: himatia leuka, hina peribalē kai mē phanerōthē hē aischynē tēs gymnotētos sou
seed.quote: white raiment, that thou mayest be clothed, and that the shame of thy nakedness do not appear

seed.name: eyesalve to see
seed.greek: kollourion enchrisai tous ophthalmous sou, hina blepēs
seed.quote: anoint thine eyes with eyesalve, that thou mayest see

rules.gloss: the Laodicean title becomes the Colossian hymn's structure

rules.sig: false riches → true treasures, addressed to Laodicea
rules.gloss: the epistle answers the seed's charge with the city named inside the answer
the clothing counsel becomes a sustained program
the canon records the letter-exchange itself

matches.greek: prōtotokos pasēs ktiseōs… hos estin archē, prōtotokos ek tōn nekrōn
matches.quote: the firstborn of every creature… who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead
matches.note: archē + ktisis as Christ-title: the Laodicean formula and the Colossian hymn share a christological collocation found essentially nowhere else — the seed's superscription unfolded into the epistle's centerpiece

matches.greek: hyper hymōn kai tōn en Laodikeia… eis pan ploutos… pantes hoi thēsauroi tēs sophias
matches.quote: for you, and for them at Laodicea… unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding… in whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom
matches.note: the self-styled rich answered with true riches — and LAODICEA IS NAMED IN THE ANSWER. The epistle addresses the seed's city inside the correction of the seed's charge.

matches.greek: apekdysamenoi ton palaion anthrōpon… endysasthe oun
matches.quote: seeing that ye have put off the old man… Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved…
matches.note: the seed's clothing counsel — be clothed, hide the nakedness — sustained across a seven-verse program of undressing and dressing

matches.greek: kai tēn ek Laodikeias hina kai hymeis anagnōte
matches.quote: and that ye likewise read the epistle from Laodicea
matches.note: THE MECHANISM: the canon's one instruction depicting letter-exchange with a city of the seven. Under Revelation-first, the 'epistle from Laodicea' is not lost — it is Rev 3:14–22, and Colossians is the answering letter, reading instruction included.

emissions.honesty: The strongest canonical-mechanism case, with one near-unique lexical anchor. Residue stated: the lukewarm/spew figure, the fire-tried gold, the door-knock-and-sup, and the throne promise find no Colossian unfolds — their elaborations, where they exist, are elsewhere. The eyesalve reaches Colossians only as the knowledge-and-understanding prayer (1:9; 2:2) — thematic. Heteronym: the letter names its own minister for the Lycus valley — Epaphras, 'one of you,' laboring 'for them in Laodicea' (4:12–13).
